SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'source_md5',md5(p.prosrc),
'ddl_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'secdef',p.prosecdef,
'config',p.proconfig,'acl',p.proacl::text,'volatility',p.provolatile::text) ORDER BY p.oid::regprocedure::text) AS metadata FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid IN ('clan_innata_private.catalogo_eligibility_release_v1()'::regprocedure,'clan_innata_private.eligibility_release_assert()'::regprocedure)
